blurb: They rent a variety of boats including ski boats, surf boats, deck boats, and jet skis for use on Lake Powell. All boats have Bluetooth stereos, bimini shades, and required safety equipment including life jackets. They also offer water toys and tow vehicles for rent, with limited launch and retrieve services.
extraNote: Tow vehicles available for $85 round trip · Launch and retrieve services available on a limited basis; reservation required · Boats must be launched from Wahweap Marina (including Stateline launch ramp) or Antelope Point (valet service). · 2026 season
